entries.title: ProteinGym: Large-Scale Benchmarks for Protein Fitness Prediction and Design
entries.abstract: ProteinGym is a large, experimentally grounded benchmark suite for protein mutation fitness prediction and design, spanning deep-mutational-scanning assays and clinical variants.
